His father had a carpet bag and several packages in his hands, and he was also conducting Rollo's mother in, and thinking about the horse and carryall. So he told Rollo that he must not speak to him then, for he could not attend to him.

58115-like-another-helen.title: Helen
58115-like-another-helen.creator: Unknown
58115-like-another-helen.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Just at sunset one day in the last week of March, 1897, a caique set sail from the harbor of Piræus, ostensibly laden with cognac for Cairo, but in reality carrying a small revolving cannon and a large number of Gras rifles to the insurgents in Crete, who had risen for the hundredth time and were fighting desperately for liberty and the Christian faith.

76603-karl-grier.title: Man with a Sixth Sense
76603-karl-grier.creator: Louis Tracy
76603-karl-grier.description: A book by Louis Tracy. Edinburgh, not to mention cosmopolitan Paris and New York, to whom he is personally known, would be exceedingly surprised were they to recognize, through the thin disguise of places and people, the popular man of the world whose extraordinary career is now set forth for the first time.

arxiv-2109-01224.title: Resilience to Denial-of-Service and Integrity Attacks: A Structured Systems Approach Note: Work supported in part by the NSF under Grants C ​ N ​ S − 1446665 CNS-1446665 and C ​ M ​ M ​ I − 1362303 CMMI-1362303 , and by the AFOSR under Grant F ​ A ​ 9550 − 15 − 10050 FA9550-15-10050 .
arxiv-2109-01224.creator: Bhaskar Ramasubramanian, M. A. Rajan, M. Girish Chandra, Rance Cleaveland, Steven I. Marcus
arxiv-2109-01224.description: Abstract The resilience of cyberphysical systems to denial-of-service (DoS) and integrity attacks is studied in this paper. The cyberphysical system is modeled as a linear structured system, and its resilience to an attack is interpreted in a graph theoretical framework.

arxiv-2111-03153.title: Are You Smarter Than a Random Expert? The Robust Aggregation of Substitutable Signals
arxiv-2111-03153.creator: Eric Neyman, Tim Roughgarden
arxiv-2111-03153.description: Abstract The problem of aggregating expert forecasts is ubiquitous in fields as wide-ranging as machine learning, economics, climate science, and national security. Despite this, our theoretical understanding of this question is fairly shallow. This paper initiates the study of forecast aggregation in a context where experts’ knowledge is chosen adversarially from a broad class of information structures.

arxiv-2401-10678.title: Four top final states with NLO accuracy in perturbative QCD: 4 lepton channel Dedication: TTK-24-02, P3H-24-001
arxiv-2401-10678.creator: Nikolaos Dimitrakopoulos, and Malgorzata Worek
arxiv-2401-10678.description: Abstract Triggered by the observation of four top-quark production at the LHC by the ATLAS and CMS collaboration we report on the calculation of the next-to-leading order QCD corrections to the Standard Model process p ​ p → t ​ t ¯ ​ t ​ t ¯ pp\to t\bar{t}t\bar{t} in the 4 ​ ℓ 4\ell top-quark decay channel.

arxiv-2406-17867.title: The Repetition Threshold for Rote Sequences
arxiv-2406-17867.creator: Nicolas Ollinger, Jeffrey Shallit
arxiv-2406-17867.description: Abstract We consider Rote words, which are infinite binary words with factor complexity 2 ​ n 2n . We prove that the repetition threshold for this class is 5 / 2 5/2 . Our technique is purely computational, using the Walnut theorem prover and a new technique for generating automata from morphisms due to the first author and his co-authors.

arxiv-2408-00425.title: Improving relativistic energy density functionals with tensor couplings
arxiv-2408-00425.creator: Stefan Typel, Shalom Shlomo
arxiv-2408-00425.description: Abstract Energy density functionals (EDFs) have been used extensively with great success to calculate properties of nuclei and to predict the equation of state (EOS) of dense nuclear matter. Besides non-relativistic EDFs, mostly of the Skyrme or Gogny type, relativistic EDFs of different types are in widespread use.

arxiv-2505-17270.title: Navigating Polytopes with Safety: A Control Barrier Function Approach
arxiv-2505-17270.creator: Tamas G. Molnar
arxiv-2505-17270.description: Abstract Collision-free motion is a fundamental requirement for many autonomous systems. This paper develops a safety-critical control approach for the collision-free navigation of polytope-shaped agents in polytope-shaped environments. A systematic method is proposed to generate control barrier function candidates in closed form that lead to controllers with formal safety guarantees.

arxiv-2512-09372.title: Intelligent Resilience Testing for Decision-Making Agents with Dual-Mode Surrogate Adaptation PubID: pubid: 0000-0000 © 2025 IEEE
arxiv-2512-09372.creator: Jingxuan Yang, Weichao Xu, Yuchen Shi, Yi Zhang, Shuo Feng, Huaxin Pei
arxiv-2512-09372.description: Abstract Testing and evaluating decision-making agents remains challenging due to unknown system architectures, limited access to internal states, and the vastness of high-dimensional scenario spaces. Existing testing approaches often rely on surrogate models of decision-making agents to generate large-scale scenario libraries; however, discrepancies between surrogate models and real decision-making agents significantly limit their generalizability and practical applicability.

europmc-pmc6624409.title: The Role of the Extracellular Matrix in Cancer Stemness.
europmc-pmc6624409.creator: Nallanthighal S, Heiserman JP, Cheon DJ.
europmc-pmc6624409.description: As our understanding of cancer cell biology progresses, it has become clear that tumors are a heterogenous mixture of different cell populations, some of which contain so called "cancer stem cells" (CSCs). Hallmarks of CSCs include self-renewing capability, tumor-initiating...

pmc-10629080.title: Ab initio protein structure prediction: the necessary presence of external force field as it is delivered by Hsp40 chaperone
pmc-10629080.creator: Irena Roterman, Katarzyna Stapor, Leszek Konieczny
pmc-10629080.description: BackgroundThe aqueous environment directs the protein folding process towards the generation of micelle-type structures, which results in the exposure of hydrophilic residues on the surface (polarity) and the concentration of hydrophobic residues in the center (hydrophobic core). Obtaining a structure without a hydrophobic core requires a different type of external force field than those generated by a water.

pmc-10692824.title: Thermoformability study of wood flour–HDPE composites with variations in wood content under vacuum forming
pmc-10692824.creator: Sanaz Afshariantorghabeh, Timo Kärki, Ville Leminen
pmc-10692824.description: Wood–plastic composites (WPCs) have emerged as sought-after substitutes for plastic. However, their use is restricted primarily to linear profiles owing to the lack of techniques for their three-dimensional (3D) forming. Thermoforming is a potential method for the 3D formation of WPCs.

pmc-11613758.title: Impact of the obesity paradox on 28-day mortality in elderly patients critically ill with cardiogenic shock: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-11613758.creator: Jing Tian, Ke Jin, Haohao Qian, Hongyang Xu
pmc-11613758.description: BackgroundPrevious studies have shown that the obesity paradox exists in cardiovascular disease (CVD), giving patients a survival advantage, but controversy remains as to whether it applies to patients with cardiogenic shock (CS), especially in the elderly. We therefore aimed to determine whether obesity affects 28-day prognosis in elderly patients with CS.

pmc-11680651.title: The association between pre-pregnancy and first-trimester hair cortisol and preterm birth: a causal inference model
pmc-11680651.creator: Yinxian Chen, Richard G. Künzel, Sixto E. Sanchez, Marta B. Rondon, Nelida I. Pinto, Elena Sanchez, Clemens Kirschbaum, Linda Valeri, Karestan C. Koenen, Bizu Gelaye
pmc-11680651.description: Adverse life events and chronic psychological distress before and during pregnancy have frequently been associated with preterm birth but the biological underpinnings remain unclear. We investigated the association between corticosteroid levels in pre-pregnancy and first-trimester hair and the risk of preterm birth. We followed N = 1,807 pregnant women from a prospective pre-birth cohort study in Lima, Perú.

pmc-12508020.title: Movement tracking of psychological processes: A tutorial using mousetrap
pmc-12508020.creator: Dirk U. Wulff, Pascal J. Kieslich, Felix Henninger, Jonas M. B. Haslbeck, Michael Schulte-Mecklenbeck
pmc-12508020.description: Movement tracking is a novel process-tracing method that promises unique access to the temporal dynamics of psychological processes. The method involves high-resolution tracking of a hand or handheld device (e.g., a computer mouse) while it is used to make a choice.

pmc-12665583.title: Presentation, management, and outcomes of orbital infections in patients with cancer
pmc-12665583.creator: Ava Niknahad, Alison B. Gibbons, Aishah Ahmed, Heya Lee, Setu Mehta, Samir Al-Ali, Meron Haile, Anjana Srikumar, Rachel Stemme, Akanksha Suresh, Justin C. Zhong, Fasika Woreta, Emily Li, Fatemeh Rajaii
pmc-12665583.description: PurposeThis study aimed to characterize the presentation, treatment, and outcomes of preseptal and orbital cellulitis in patients with and without cancer, to help guide management of these infections.MethodsA retrospective cohort study was conducted at a tertiary care center to identify adults who presented from 2007 to 2022 with orbital and preseptal cellulitis.

pmc-12958869.title: Understanding clients’ and providers’ perspectives on the implementation of subcutaneous depot medroxyprogesterone acetate (DMPA-SC) for self-injection programming in Nigeria
pmc-12958869.creator: Sneha Challa, Madeline Griffith, Ayobambo Jegede, Aminat Tijani, Emily Himes, Ivan Idiodi, Chioma Okoli, Shakede Dimowo, Elizabeth Omoluabi, Jenny X Liu
pmc-12958869.description: Subcutaneous depot medroxyprogesterone acetate (DMPA-SC) is an injectable contraceptive method with a small needle and prefilled syringe system that has been approved for self-injection (SI) by clients. As DMPA-SC for SI programmes are being scaled, employing an implementation science lens is critical to understanding what works.

pmc-13294919.title: Fibroblast-Derived Decellularized Extracellular Matrix as a Bioactive Substrate for Osteoblast Activation
pmc-13294919.creator: Devy F Garna, Agata Szubska, Sama Salman, Aisha Mohammed, Lucy Di-Silvio
pmc-13294919.description: The extracellular matrix (ECM) plays a critical role in regulating cell behavior and is increasingly incorporated into biomaterial design. However, the reproducible generation of cell-derived ECM remains challenging due to variability in decellularization methods. This study refines a detergent-based protocol for preparing fibroblast-derived ECM and evaluates its effects on primary human osteoblasts (HOBs).

pmc-13384232.title: The Neural Distribution of Vasotocin, Oxytocin, Dopamine, and Serotonin in Two Australian Skinks With Contrasting Social Lives
pmc-13384232.creator: Jai Lake, Martin J. Whiting, Geoffrey M. While, David Kabelik, Dustin R. Rubenstein, Daniel Hoops
pmc-13384232.description: The neurotransmitters vasotocin, oxytocin, dopamine, and serotonin are widely involved in vertebrate social behavior, and changes in their abundance and distribution in the brain have been linked to the evolution of complex sociality. Reptiles provide an excellent system in which to investigate the neural mechanisms of social living.

pmc-13433576.title: Distractor avoidance is achieved by active control rather than passive exclusion
pmc-13433576.creator: Xiaojin Ma, Richard A. Abrams
pmc-13433576.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). When navigating the visual world, we have considerable control over what stimuli to select for deeper processing, and we can often resist capture by physically salient but task-irrelevant distractors. A debate has emerged regarding whether distractor avoidance is accomplished by active goal-driven attentional control, or by passive exclusion of distractors from the narrow attentional focus of a highly serial search, as the attentional window account claims.

pmc-13457008.title: Global trends and hotspots in diabetes and hearing loss: a 20-year systematic bibliometric study
pmc-13457008.creator: Zhaoquan Yi, Xinying Ni, Mingxiao Guo, Hua Shao, Xuelei Chen, Fang Zhang
pmc-13457008.description: BackgroundDiabetes and hearing loss are increasingly recognized as critical global public health concerns. Cumulative evidence indicates a close association between diabetes and auditory impairment; however, the knowledge structure, research hotspots, and developmental trends in this field remain insufficiently and systematically characterized.

pmc-13511845.title: Factors Associated with Exercise Adherence Across Settings Among Stroke Survivors in China: A Systematic Review of Cross-Sectional Studies
pmc-13511845.creator: Su Sean Yong, Qifei Chen, Zhiping Liao, Fangchao Wu, Jianhua Li, Qi Si
pmc-13511845.description: Background/Objectives: Exercise is an important component of rehabilitation programmes for stroke survivors, and adherence is key to ensuring the effectiveness of rehabilitation. However, adherence declines over time, especially as stroke survivors transition from in-hospital to post-discharge settings. The present review synthesised evidence on factors associated with exercise adherence among stroke survivors in China across two settings, using the socio-ecological model.
